faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: When an athlete enters an active training contract with a coach, they become a Covered Client. The coach manages their active training program, temporarily locking solo routine creation while giving the athlete full access to execute and log their coach's prescribed workouts.
faq.q2: Can I switch between Free and Plus?: Can I switch between Free and Plus?
faq.q2: Can I switch between Free and Plus?
faq.a2: Yes. Upgrades immediately expand your client capacity and template limits. If you downgrade, a 24-hour grace period is granted before overflow routines or exercises are softly hidden—never deleted.
faq.q3: Where do athletes access the mobile app?
faq.a3: Gymmi Mobile is built natively for iOS and Android, allowing athletes to log weights, record RPE, and check off sets in real-time right on the gym floor.
faq.q4: How does Gemini AI translation work?
faq.a4: Gymmi utilizes Google Gemini AI to translate custom exercises and routine instructions automatically between English and Spanish, enabling seamless bilingual coaching.
faq.q5: When will the Pro tier be available?
faq.a5: The Pro tier is currently in active development. It will introduce unlimited client capacity, team collaboration for fitness studios, and advanced analytics.
faq.q6: How do Strength Standards & Leaderboards work?
faq.a6: Gymmi automatically computes peak estimated 1RM using Epley's scientific formula across logged exercise sets. Athletes achieve calibrated strength tiers (Diamond, Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze) on core compound lifts. Facility coaches and gym owners can track cohort rankings across weekly, monthly, and all-time cycles.
faq.q7: How does Gymmi work for gym facilities and studios?
faq.a7: Gym facilities receive a dedicated management web console. You can curate facility-wide workout catalogs, approve personal trainers to represent your gym with optional routine publishing rights, track active member capacity against your tier (starting at 100 members with a 30-day free trial on Plus), and publish exclusive member announcements.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of these Terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Service (the "Terms") are a binding agreement between you and {{company}} ("Gymmi", "we", "us") covering the Gymmi website, the web portal, the Gymmi mobile applications, and the related APIs and services (together, the "Service").

By creating an account, downloading the app, or otherwise using the Service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least {{minAge}} years old to create an account. If you are under the age of legal majority where you live, you may only use the Service with the consent and supervision of a parent or legal guardian, who agrees to these Terms on your behalf and is responsible for your use of the Service.
You may not use the Service if you are barred from doing so under applicable law, or if your account was previously suspended or removed by us.

sections.title: 3. Your account
paragraphs: You register as an Athlete (Client), a Personal Trainer, or a Gym. You agree to provide accurate information, including your physical profile, coaching credentials, or facility details, and to keep it up to date.

You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account. Tell us immediately at {{email}} if you suspect unauthorized access. We may temporarily lock sign-in after repeated failed attempts to protect your account.

sections.title: 4. What Gymmi provides
paragraphs: Gymmi is a training platform. It lets you build and follow workout routines, browse an exercise catalog, log workout sessions, view training analytics, strength classifications and leaderboards, read and publish articles, and connect Athletes with Personal Trainers and Gyms.
We may add, change, or remove features at any time. Some features are only available on certain platforms, roles, or plans.

sections.title: 5. Health and fitness disclaimer
paragraphs: Gymmi is not a medical service and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Routines, exercise instructions, articles, analytics, estimated one-rep maxes, and strength tiers are for general information only and are estimates.

Consult a physician before starting any exercise program, especially if you are pregnant, have a medical condition, or are recovering from an injury. Stop exercising immediately and seek medical help if you feel pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
Physical exercise carries an inherent risk of injury. You exercise voluntarily and at your own risk, and you are responsible for using proper technique, equipment, and supervision.

sections.title: 6. Trainers, gyms, and contracts
paragraphs: Personal Trainers and Gyms are independent third parties. They are not employees, agents, or representatives of Gymmi. We do not verify certifications, qualifications, or facility conditions, and we do not guarantee the quality or results of any coaching or facility.

Coaching contracts, rates, and gym memberships are agreed directly between Athletes, Trainers, and Gyms. Unless stated otherwise, Gymmi is not a party to those agreements and does not process payments between them. Any dispute about them must be resolved between the parties involved.

Trainers and Gyms who receive Athlete data (such as workout history and analytics) through the Service may only use it to provide their services to that Athlete, and must protect it in line with applicable law.

sections.title: 7. Plans, payments, and trials
paragraphs: Gymmi offers a Free plan and a paid Plus plan. Plan limits (for example, the number of routines, clients, or custom exercises) are shown on our pricing page and may change with notice.

Plus subscriptions are purchased only on the Gymmi web portal, using the manual payment methods listed there (such as Pago Móvil, bank transfer, Zinli, Binance Pay, or Zelle). You submit your payment reference and receipt, and our team verifies it manually. Once approved, your plan is active for 30 days (monthly) or 365 days (annual), added to any remaining paid time. Subscriptions do not renew automatically.

The Gymmi mobile apps do not sell subscriptions or digital content and do not use Apple In-App Purchase or Google Play Billing. Features you unlock on the web are available in the mobile apps when you sign in to the same account.

New Gym accounts may receive a free trial with the duration and member capacity shown during signup. When a trial or paid period ends, your account returns to the Free plan limits. Content above those limits may be hidden, not deleted, until you upgrade again.

Payments are final once verified, except where a refund is required by law or we fail to activate the plan you paid for. If a payment cannot be verified, we will reject it and tell you why. To request a refund, contact {{email}}.

sections.title: 8. Your content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of the content you submit, including routines, custom exercises, articles, comments, photos, logos, and payment receipts ("User Content"). You grant Gymmi a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to host, store, reproduce, translate, display, and distribute your User Content only as needed to operate and improve the Service and to show it to the people you share it with.

You confirm that you have the rights needed to share your User Content and that it does not infringe anyone's rights. Routines or exercises that you share or assign can be copied by the people who receive them.

sections.title: 9. Community rules and zero tolerance
paragraphs: Gymmi has zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users. You must not post, upload, or share anything that:
bullets: is sexually explicit, pornographic, violent, hateful, discriminatory, or harassing;
threatens, bullies, defames, or impersonates another person;
promotes self-harm, eating disorders, illegal drugs, or unsafe use of performance-enhancing substances;
contains spam, scams, malware, or unsolicited advertising;
infringes intellectual property or privacy rights, or discloses someone else's personal data without permission;
is otherwise illegal or harmful to minors.
paragraphsAfter: You also must not reverse engineer, scrape, overload, or interfere with the Service, bypass plan limits or security measures, or access other users' accounts.

You can report objectionable content or abusive users directly in the app or web portal: use Report on any article, comment, or user, and use Block to hide a user's articles and comments from you. You can also write to {{email}}. We review reports within 24 hours, and we may remove content and suspend or remove the accounts responsible without notice.

sections.title: 10. Third-party services
paragraphs: The Service relies on third-party providers, for example cloud hosting, Cloudflare R2 for storing images, and Google Gemini to translate exercise catalog text between English and Spanish. Their processing of data is described in our Privacy Policy.
Links to third-party websites or payment providers are offered for convenience. We are not responsible for their content, availability, or terms.

sections.title: 11. Privacy
paragraphs: Our Privacy Policy, published at /privacy on the Gymmi website, explains what personal data we collect, including your physical profile, workout history, photos, and payment references, how we use it, who we share it with, and the rights you have. By using the Service you acknowledge that policy.

sections.title: 12. Account deletion, suspension, and termination
paragraphs: You can stop using the Service at any time and delete your account yourself: in the Gymmi app go to Profile → Delete account, or on the web go to Settings → Delete account (no app installation needed). You must confirm your password. Deletion is immediate and permanent: your profile, workouts, sessions, assignments, contracts, articles, comments and uploaded images are deleted, and payment records we must keep for legal, tax, or anti-fraud obligations are anonymized and detached from you.
If you cannot access your account, you can also request deletion by writing to {{email}} from the email address registered to your account; we will delete or anonymize your data within 30 days.

We may suspend or terminate your access at any time if you violate these Terms, if required by law, or to protect users or the Service. Sections that by their nature should survive termination (including content licenses already granted to recipients, disclaimers, and limitations of liability) will survive.

This policy applies to every Gymmi user: Athletes (Clients), Personal Trainers, and Gyms. It should be read together with our Terms of Service.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: We only collect the data you give us or that is created when you use the Service:
bullets: Account data: email address, username, and password. We never store your password in plain text; we keep only a one-way hash of it. We also keep your role, plan, and account dates.
Physical profile (Athletes): age, gender, height, weight, and fitness goal.

Workout data: routines, custom exercises, workout sessions (start and end times, sets, weights, repetitions, rest, and effort ratings), and the analytics, personal records, strength classifications, and leaderboard positions calculated from them.
Trainer profile: description, specializations, monthly rate, gyms where you train, and your logo.
Gym data: gym name, description, address, city, phone number, website, amenities, logo, cover image, member capacity, and the list of members and affiliated coaches.
Images you upload: profile photos, trainer and gym logos, gym covers, article covers, and payment receipts.

Payment data: plan, billing cycle, amount, payment method, reference number, originating bank, payer phone number, payer national ID number, and the receipt image you submit, plus our review status and notes. We do not collect or store card numbers.
Community content: articles, comments, likes, and bookmarks.
Relationship data: trainer contracts (dates, status, and the optional message you send), gym memberships and coach affiliations.
Technical data: sign-in tokens that keep you logged in, and your IP address, which we use temporarily to block abusive traffic and do not store in your profile.

sections.title: 3. Data we do not collect
paragraphs: Gymmi does not collect your precise location, contacts, browsing history, advertising identifiers, or data from Apple Health or Google Fit. The apps contain no advertising and no third-party tracking or analytics SDKs, and we do not track you across other companies' apps or websites.
The mobile apps ask for access to your camera or photo library only when you choose to add an image, such as a profile photo or a payment receipt. Only the image you select is uploaded.

sections.title: 4. How we use your data
paragraphs: We use each type of data only for the purposes below:
bullets: Account data: to create and secure your account, sign you in, and contact you about your account, payments, or reports.

Physical profile and workout data: to log your training and calculate analytics, estimated one-rep maxes, strength classifications, and leaderboards, and to share your progress with the Trainers and Gyms you connect with.
Trainer and gym data: to show your public profile so Athletes can find you and to manage contracts, members, and coaches.
Images: to display them where you added them, and in the case of receipts, to verify your payment.
Payment data: to verify manual payments, activate your plan, prevent fraud, and meet accounting and tax obligations.
Community content: to publish it to other users and to moderate it under our zero-tolerance rules.
Technical data: to keep the Service secure, prevent abuse, and fix problems.
paragraphsAfter: We do not sell your personal data, use it for advertising, or use it for automated decisions that have legal or similarly significant effects on you.

sections.title: 5. Legal bases
paragraphs: We process your data because it is needed to provide the Service you signed up for, because you consented (for example, to an optional physical profile or to connecting with a Trainer or Gym), to comply with legal obligations (such as keeping payment records), and for our legitimate interests in keeping the Service secure and free of abuse. Where we rely on consent, you can withdraw it at any time.

sections.title: 6. What other users can see
paragraphs: Some of your data is visible to other users so the Service can work:
bullets: Personal Trainers with whom you have an active contract can see your username, email address, workout sessions, and training analytics.

Gyms you join can see your username, email address, profile photo, physical profile (age, gender, height, weight, and fitness goal), and the training related to routines the Gym or its coaches assign to you.
Trainer and Gym profiles, published articles, comments, and your username and profile photo next to them are visible to other users. Leaderboards show your username and ranking.
Routines or exercises that you share or assign can be seen and copied by the people who receive them.
paragraphsAfter: Trainers and Gyms may only use Athlete data to provide their services to that Athlete. Ending a contract or leaving a Gym stops further access.

sections.title: 7. Service providers
paragraphs: We use a small number of providers who process data on our behalf, under contracts that limit their use of it to providing their service to us:
bullets: Cloud hosting and database providers, which run our servers and store account, profile, workout, and payment data.
Cloudflare R2, which stores the images you upload (profile photos, logos, covers, and payment receipts).
Google Gemini, which we use only to translate exercise catalog text between English and Spanish. We do not send your personal data to Gemini.
paragraphsAfter: We may also disclose data when required by law or a valid legal request, to protect the rights, safety, or property of our users or Gymmi, or as part of a merger or sale of the business, in which case the successor must honor this policy.

sections.title: 8. How long we keep data
paragraphs: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. Images that you replace, such as an old profile photo or logo, are deleted. Content you delete, such as a workout, article, or comment, is removed from the Service.

When you delete your account, your personal data is deleted immediately (or within 30 days for requests made by email). We may keep anonymized payment records for as long as accounting, tax, or anti-fraud laws require, and data needed to resolve a dispute or enforce our Terms until it is resolved.

sections.title: 9. Security
paragraphs: We protect your data with encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, short-lived sign-in tokens, role-based access controls, and rate limiting against brute-force attempts. Uploaded files get random, unguessable names.
No system is completely secure. If we learn of a breach that affects your personal data, we will notify you and the authorities as required by law.

sections.title: 10. Your rights and choices
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you have the right to:
bullets: access the personal data we hold about you and get a copy of it;
correct inaccurate data; you can edit most of your profile directly in the app or web portal;
delete your account and personal data;
object to or restrict certain processing, and withdraw consent at any time;
receive your data in a portable format;
complain to your local data protection authority.
paragraphsAfter: To exercise any of these rights, write to {{email}} from the email address registered to your account. We may ask you to confirm your identity, and we will reply within 30 days.

sections.title: 11. Deleting your account
paragraphs: You can delete your Gymmi account yourself at any time: in the Gymmi app go to Profile → Delete account, or on the web portal go to Settings → Delete account (no app installation needed). You will be asked to confirm your password. Deletion is immediate and permanent and removes your account, profile, workout history, images, contracts, memberships, articles, and comments. Payment records that we must keep by law are anonymized and detached from you, as described in section 8.
If you cannot sign in, you can request deletion by writing to {{email}} from the email address registered to your account; we will complete it within 30 days.
Uninstalling the app does not delete your account.

sections.title: 12. Children
paragraphs: The Service is not directed to children under {{minAge}}, and you must be at least {{minAge}} years old to create an account. If you are under the age of legal majority where you live, you may only use the Service with the consent and supervision of a parent or legal guardian.
If we learn that we have collected personal data from a child under {{minAge}}, we will delete it. Parents or guardians who believe this has happened can contact us at {{email}}.

sections.title: 13. International transfers
paragraphs: Our service providers may store and process your data on servers outside your country, including in the United States. When we transfer data internationally, we take steps to make sure it keeps a level of protection consistent with this policy and with applicable law.

sections.title: 14. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will change the "Last updated" date and, for material changes, notify you by email or in the Service before they take effect.

sections.title: 15. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions, requests about your data, or account deletion, contact {{company}} at {{email}}. This policy is governed by the laws of {{jurisdiction}}, without depriving you of the protection of the mandatory data protection laws of the country where you live.
